title: Editorial | GivingTuesday 2026 Guides and Charity Campaigns | Influencers Involved
description: Explore GivingTuesday 2026 guides for donors and creators, plus sourced features on four animal-related charity campaigns for December 1.
ogTitle: GivingTuesday 2026: Guides, Causes and Real Campaigns
ogDescription: Practical advice for December 1, with official sources and independent stories behind animal-related charitable campaigns.
intro: GivingTuesday brings many kinds of generosity into focus. If you're wondering how to take part, how to choose a cause, or how to share a campaign responsibly, start here. We explain the essentials, then look closely at four animal-related organizations with published plans for December 1, 2026.
transparency: These are independent articles by Influencers Involved, Inc. NFP. We are not the organizer of GivingTuesday, and none of the featured charities is presented as our partner or endorser. When you choose to donate to a featured charity, use that charity's official giving page.
closing: Campaign figures, dates and matching opportunities may change. Please consult each charity's official website before giving.
